kind: Fixed semantic review of repairs that preserve original Core questions, before per-item judgments
goal: Actual original-question/query/required-field scoring agreement, not a rating target
question_preservation: The admitted task uses the original question_en bytes. Revised prose may be explanation only; it cannot replace the evaluated original question.
scope: Begin with all 383 proposed clarifications. The label is a candidate pool, never a semantic pass. Account separately for all 560 original IDs and retain the 177 variants as unresolved until evidence for the original meaning is established.
semantic_units: unverified additional inputs or external interpretation
pass_requires: An AI reviewer independently derives the requested semantics from the ORIGINAL question and preserved source context, then maps every unit to actual reference-query clauses and requested-field contract. Missing evidence is pending; changed intended meaning is blocked. No pass solely from the old clarification label, native execution, agreement count or generic template rationale.
query_repair: Reference query repair is allowed when it implements the original question without adding scope choices. Distinguish scorer_only (query bytes unchanged) from query_and_scorer (question preserved, reference query repaired).
reference_evidence: Captured native output is reusable only with exact actual query hash, full-output receipt and pinned frozen graph/source inventory. Rewording a question does not validate its intended scope.
source_context: Use original benchmark WG/phase, schema and graph-relative process context. Do not convert an external/practical/causal/semantic question to a raw node count by fiat.
scoring_evidence: Require all requested named fields with type/role/collection/cardinality/tie rules and wrong-value/count/attribute/field/type negative checks. No extra unrequested query projection is made a required answer.
independent_review: Record two separate AI semantic judgments and their item-level evidence before counting newly confirmed repairs. If disagreement remains, report pending or blocked. Root integration is not human author or expert endorsement.
reporting: Original unchanged validated diagnostics, original-question-preserving repairs, changed-question variants, and unresolved originals have disjoint accounting. All original 560 IDs remain visible. Do not sum the separate 36 model variants into original coverage.
performance: No new model performance claim or transferred historical score. Any rescoring requires compatible preserved predictions and all requested fields; otherwise new predictions are required.
all_core_complete: All original 560 must pass to claim full-original completion. A smaller admitted original-question repair set has its own explicit denominator; quarantine is not full-original completion.
